verdict.label: not_comparable
verdict.rationale: The two claims concern different treatment lines and different comparators: A examines second-line sulfonylureas versus non-SU second-line therapy (DPP4i/TZD) in Scotland, while B examines first-line sulphonylureas versus metformin in the UK. The exposure contrast is not sufficiently similar, so the findings cannot be compared.

source_evidence.quote: initiated second-line pharmacotherapy (SU/DPP4i/TZD) on or after 1 January 2010
To determine whether adiposity modified the effect on the cardiovascular safety of sulphonylureas as a first-line therapy compared with metformin among patients with type 2 diabetes.
